physicalNotes: Radius 1.271 Jupiter radii from Gillon et al. 2013 (2013A&A...552A..82G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...552A..82G/abstract): 90,866.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.271 Jupiter masses (Gillon et al. 2013, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2013A&A...552A..82G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...552A..82G/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
